name: Shopping Agent Blueprint Starter Guide
description_md:
Try Anthropic’s shopping-agent blueprint with a focused first-test guide before connecting your store.

Repo: Direct link to the maintained open-source project. First test: Copyable setup prompt and three retail checks. Review: Merchant approval exercise and a live-store readiness checklist.

Free Markdown guide in a ZIP. Documentation inspected; software execution remains your own test. Optional contributions default to zero.
